hero_kpi_rationale: No distinct wow factor identified. R&D KPI is selected as a proxy for technological leadership in a deep tech sector with high innovation intensity.

kpis.name: R&D Investments
kpis.explanation: Expenses dedicated to the research and development of new technologies.
kpis.description: R&D expenses more than doubled year-over-year, rising from $26.7M in 2024 to $58.9M in 2025, driven by the hiring of 68 new employees and increased professional services costs.
kpis.signal: Explosive growth in R&D spending, indicating accelerated technological development.

kpis.name: General and Administrative Expenses
kpis.explanation: Costs related to administrative, legal, accounting, and support functions.
kpis.description: G&A expenses tripled between 2024 ($26.1M) and 2025 ($80.4M), driven by an increase of 53 employees and a significant rise in professional fees, particularly legal and accounting.
kpis.signal: Sharp increase in G&A expenses, linked to headcount growth and the complexity of being a public company.

kpis.name: Net Loss
kpis.explanation: Annual loss after all expenses and taxes.
kpis.description: Oklo reported a net loss of $105.7M in 2025, consistent with its status as a pre-commercial company making substantial investments in its technologies.
kpis.signal: Significant net loss, but expected for a startup in development phase.

kpis.name: Cash and Securities
kpis.explanation: Liquidity available to fund operations and future investments.
kpis.description: As of December 31, 2025, Oklo held $1.41 billion in cash and securities, primarily from equity issuances in 2025.
kpis.signal: High cash balance, strengthening the ability to fund development without immediate fundraising.

kpis.name: Operating Cash Flow
kpis.explanation: Amount of cash used by the company's core operating activities.
kpis.description: Operating cash flow doubled in 2025 ($82.2M used vs $38.4M in 2024), reflecting accelerated spending related to development.
kpis.signal: Growing use of operating cash flow, consistent with scaling phase.

kpis.name: Investing Cash Flow
kpis.explanation: Cash used for purchases of assets, securities, or investments.
kpis.description: In 2025, $489.7M was used in investing activities, including $443.5M for the purchase of marketable securities and $33.2M in capital expenditures related to facilities.
kpis.signal: Massive investments in 2025, particularly in marketable securities and equipment.

kpis.name: Financing Cash Flow
kpis.explanation: Cash inflows from fundraising or equity issuances.
kpis.description: Oklo raised $1.26 billion in 2025 through equity issuances, compared to $301.4M in 2024, marking a significant acceleration in financing.
kpis.signal: Strong capital inflow in 2025, supporting future growth.

kpis.name: R&D Investments
kpis.explanation: Expenses dedicated to the research and development of new technologies.
kpis.description: R&D expenses grew 120% year-over-year, supported by hiring and external service costs.

kpis.name: General and Administrative Expenses
kpis.explanation: Costs related to administrative, legal, accounting, and support functions.
kpis.description: G&A expenses tripled year-over-year, reflecting organizational complexity and public company costs.
kpis.signal: Rapid scaling of administrative cost structure.

risks.title: Absence of binding power purchase agreement
risks.score_rationale: The risk is mentioned in the first section of the 10-K, with strong language (no guarantee, material adverse effect). It is central to the business model and repeated multiple times, indicating a major concern. The Competition category is weighted as it impacts the ability to gain market share.

risks.title: Dependence on limited suppliers for critical components
risks.score_rationale: The text highlights reliance on specialized suppliers for unique components, with strong warning language (challenging, may not be commercially available). This risk is repeated and tied to plant construction, making it an existential issue.

risks.title: No guaranteed regulatory approval for its reactors
risks.score_rationale: The document states that no license has been filed or obtained with the NRC, with alarming language (not guaranteed, highly regulated). Nuclear regulation is highly intensive, and this risk is fundamental to deployment.

risks.title: Potential loss of key personnel
risks.score_rationale: The risk is explicitly mentioned with strong language (material adverse effect). The category is weighted because the company is in startup phase and heavily reliant on its executives. Positioned centrally in the 10-K.

risks.title: Unavailability of HALEU or plutonium-based fuel
risks.score_rationale: The text emphasizes the lack of large-scale availability of HALEU and plutonium-based fuels, with regulatory and construction challenges. Strong language (not currently available at scale, may take longer or cost more). Existential risk for reactor operations.

risks.title: Loss of confidence due to negative public perception of nuclear energy
risks.score_rationale: The risk is mentioned implicitly in the context of regulatory challenges and public perception of nuclear energy. Although less explicitly detailed than other risks, the nuclear sector faces persistent public perception concerns.

ai_positioning.summary: There is no significant mention of artificial intelligence in the company Oklo's 10-K report.
